Name: Tainted Cellar
Author: jinxiewinxie
Description:
Adds a giant cellar to your farm =)

Features:
- kitchen w/ working sink (watersource)
- growing place w/ working watersource
- mini bar
- a study
- a working radio
- space for your machines
- replaces no files!

Also:
[list]
[*][b]WHAT: [i][b]configurable option of where to the place cellar itself. (for smaller house reskins, or people who prefer it to be on the the opposite end)[/b][/i][/b]
[*][b]now compatible with ALL and TFE's cellar addition.[/b]
[*][b]can be set to only be unlocked after final house upgrade.[/b]
[*][b]actually can use dirt tiles now, game reads cellar as part of farm area.[/b]
[*][b]now comes with a folder with alt packed colors (currently only creme) and an unpacked zpaths_object_cellar.png to edit of the cellar (user must interchange it themselves /it will still be set as pink by default)[/b]
[/list]
This Mod is a collaboration between TaintedWheat and Jinxiewinxie. You can learn more about on the [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/smapi-underground-house-cellar-what-update-6-26.115735/]Stardew Valley Forums[/url].
